install: set -euo pipefail; git submodule update --init --recursive; HUGO_VERSION=0.169.0; mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin"; if ! "$HOME/.local/bin/hugo" version 2>/dev/null | grep "v${HUGO_VERSION}.*+extended" >/dev/null; then case "$(uname -m)" in x86_64|amd64) HUGO_ARCH=amd64 ;; aarch64|arm64) HUGO_ARCH=arm64 ;; *) echo "Unsupported architecture: $(uname -m)" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac; TMP_DIR="$(mktemp -d)"; trap 'rm -rf "${TMP_DIR:-}"' EXIT; curl -fsSL "https://github.com/gohugoio/hugo/releases/download/v${HUGO_VERSION}/hugo_extended_${HUGO_VERSION}_linux-${HUGO_ARCH}.tar.gz" -o "$TMP_DIR/hugo.tar.gz"; tar -xzf "$TMP_DIR/hugo.tar.gz" -C "$TMP_DIR" hugo; install -m 0755 "$TMP_DIR/hugo" "$HOME/.local/bin/hugo"; fi; touch "$HOME/.bashrc"; sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || true; grep -qxF 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"
